title: Senior ML Ops (x/f/m)
description:
Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We are looking for a Senior MLOps Engineer to join the ML Platform team.

Your mission will be to build and scale the infrastructure that brings machine learning to life at Doctolib - powering AI-driven solutions that improve the daily experience of care teams and patients across Europe. You will work in a cross-functional team developing the ML platform and tooling that underpins Doctolib's AI products, contributing directly to faster, more reliable deployment of models that have a real impact on healthcare delivery.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Build and deploy production-grade machine learning models in close collaboration with data scientists and engineers, ensuring performance, scalability, and reliability

• Design and maintain the MLOps pipeline, including version control, CI/CD, and monitoring of ML models in production

• Develop tools, frameworks, and best practices to streamline the model development and deployment lifecycle

• Ensure the availability and performance of ML systems, proactively identifying and resolving issues before they impact users

• Partner with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, provide technical guidance, and contribute to the development of end-to-end ML solutions

• Share and advocate MLOps knowledge across the tech community, documenting processes, standards, and best practices to drive consistency and knowledge transfer

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

• Are proficient in Python, SQL, Shell Scripting, and Terraform, with hands-on experience building and containerizing ML pipelines with Docker

• Have solid knowledge of cloud platforms, particularly AWS services such as SageMaker, EC2, ECS, S3, and CloudWatch (and/or Azure equivalents)

• Have a good understanding of machine learning algorithms, concepts, and trends, including hands-on experience with Deep Learning frameworks - preferably PyTorch

• Have excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and produce clear technical documentation

• Have a strong team spirit, a genuine enthusiasm for learning, and a proactive sense of initiative

• Are fluent in English

It would be fantastic if you:

• Have experience with Kubernetes, GitOps tools (e.g. ArgoCD), and/or Kafka

• Have experience with ML model quantization, optimization, and HuggingFace technologies (Transformers, Accelerate, PEFT)

• Have experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and browser-based model deployment (transformers.js / langchain.js)

Life at Doctolib Tech

• Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

• Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

• We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here .

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site .

What we offer

• Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

• 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

• Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

• Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

• Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

• A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class

• 50% reimbursement of your public transport subs

title: Team Leader, Trust & Safety Operations

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

title: Senior Technical Product Manager Hardware
description:
Overview
Rachio is looking for a Senior Product Manager Hardware to own one of Rachio's hardware lines end to end: the roadmap for that line, the product definition behind each device in it, and the stage gates that take a concept from idea through EVT, DVT, and PVT to a product that ships on time, in full, and at the right cost.
Our hardware portfolio spans smart sprinkler controllers, hose timers, outdoor lighting, and the partner and OEM products we build with and for others, along with the tethered software experiences (setup, control, and device features in the Rachio app) that make them work. You will own a subset of these hardware programs from its roadmap, its definition, requirements, and its results - and how it feeds it into the portfolio roadmap.
The role is inherently technical and inherently commercial. You are measured on shipping products customers love - on time, at cost, and at quality - and on how your line performs in market: activation, returns, CSAT, and attach to software and subscriptions. Not on the volume of specs written. You work daily with Engineering (firmware, electrical, mechanical, and industrial design), Supply Chain and Operations, Design, Support, Finance, and Sales. You will spend real time with customers - homeowners and professional installers - and real time at the factory. This enables our customer driven approach and how we solve customer pain points in our roadmap.
A note on how this role works. Rachio runs a flat organization that maintains high ownership and a fast-paced start-up culture. This is an individual contributor role. Your influence comes from the quality of your product judgment, the clarity of your writing, and your credibility with the engineers, designers, and operators who build what you define. If there is a gap in the organization or resourcing standing between your product and its launch, you are expected to step in and close it. When the same gap shows up a second time, you are expected to fix what produces it.
We also expect you to work AI-natively: using AI for the research synthesis, data analysis, and first drafts that used to take days, so your time goes to customers, evaluating trade-offs, and focusing on strategic debates.
Responsibilities
Own your line's roadmap and product definition

• Own the roadmap for your hardware line across new products, line extensions, and lifecycle work on what has already shipped, kept led by data: customer research, product telemetry, support and returns data, channel input, and competitive intelligence.

• Write the "working backwards" documents for each new product and major feature in your line: the customer problem, the value to customers, partners, and channels, the target price and cost, the success criteria, and the questions we have to answer before we commit.

• Turn those into detailed, crisp business requirements and user stories that Engineering and Design can build to, spanning hardware, firmware, and the tethered app experience.

• Manage the trade-offs among customer experience, performance, cost, schedule, and operational support load - and make the call, with a written rationale, when they conflict.

• Feed the portfolio roadmap: bring the Director of Product the evidence, the sequencing constraints, and the bets you think are worth making in your category.

Run the product development process for your line

• Run your line's stage gates as a mechanism, not a meeting: concept through EVT, DVT, PVT, and ramp, with clear owners and exit criteria at each, and an honest review of what we learned at the end.

• Contribute to engineering decisions on technology and architecture - radios and protocols, sensors, power, enclosures - with enough fluency to be useful in the room and to recognize when a decision is a one-way door.

title: Software Architect - Tracking
description:
This is the senior computer vision engineering authority for Hawk-Eye's tracking technology, and it is an individual contributor role.

Our tracking sits underneath almost everything Hawk-Eye sells. Goal-line technology, semi-automated offside, electronic line calling, automated ball-strike. Live and post-game data. It runs across football, baseball, tennis, American football, ice hockey, cricket, basketball and rugby, on-premise, in the cloud and increasingly on edge devices, delivered by over 100 engineers in the Tracking and Automated Officiating value stream.

You would be the person who decides how that is built. The role carries two hats. As Software Architect you own the software-level architectural design across tracking, auto-officiating and data delivery. As computer vision authority you lead the core domains: camera calibration, ball tracking, skeletal tracking, and the R&D that feeds them.

It is a hands-on job. You set architecture for new tracking problems as they arrive, you safeguard the shared frameworks, and when a live delivery is at risk you are the escalation point who gets into the code.

WHAT YOU WOULD OWN

Architecture across the value stream. You are the lead architect for every tracking and auto-officiating product in T&AO. You set the initial architecture when a new tracking problem enters the business, run the Software Domain Owner model so shared libraries like calibration have named codeowners, and keep designs consistent across sports. You represent tracking in the Engineering Architecture Steering group and feed into architecture conversations across Hawk-Eye and the wider Sony Sports organisation.

Part of that is judgement about reuse. Keeping value streams on a common tracking codebase pays off until it doesn't, and knowing where that line sits is the job.

Computer vision direction. You are the subject matter authority. You decide where our vision processing and ML integration goes next, research new tracking technologies and bring them in, and build prototypes when a proposal needs proving rather than describing.

Modern tooling, properly evaluated. We want agentic coding frameworks, LLM-driven development tools and automated code generation working inside heavy C++ and Python codebases, with guidelines that hold up. You would lead that adoption and decide what earns its place.

Growing other engineers. You coach the Squad Tech Leads, guide junior architects, and run CV Algorithm talks, HawkTalks and tutorials. You also help us hire well, including technical assessment for CV and ML roles.

The awkward bits. Operational health of ML training and synthetic data infrastructure sits with you, including escalating the gaps in ownership and support with options attached.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

The core of it is deep multi-camera computer vision. Camera calibration including intrinsics, extrinsics, distortion models, anti-wobble and bundle adjustment. Triangulation. 3D ball and pose estimation, skeletal tracking, continuous-time modelling, inverse kinematics.

On top of that:

- Expert cross-platform C++ across Windows and Linux, x86 and ARM, with CMake and real performance profiling ability

- Strong working knowledge of GPU inference (TensorRT, Triton) and ML pipelines (PyTorch, ONNX)

- Proven experience running tracking at scale in AWS, on-premise and on edge devices

- Hands-on use of AI coding agents and LLM orchestration to accelerate algorithm R&D and refactoring in large codebases

- A working understanding of generative AI, synthetic data generation and where they genuinely help real-time CV

The parts that are harder to put in a bullet point. You can set architecture across many squads and sports and make pragmatic calls on reuse, cost and time to market. You write clearly: design documents, proposals with options, explanations a non-technical stakeholder can follow. You are comfortable in front of external engineering partners, which here means Sony, NVIDIA and AWS alongside sports

title: Post-doctorant.e : "Simulation numérique 3D de l’infusion de composites à fibres naturelles" - CDD 12 mois
tags: Génie des procédés, système de production et fabrication avancée
description:
ENGLISH VERSION

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne , c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable . Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain .
Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.
L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

Bienvenue dans l’univers des matériaux du futur !
Au centre Science des Matériaux et des Structures (SMS), rattaché au Laboratoire Georges Friedel (unité mixte de recherche CNRS), on décortique la matière pour mieux la maîtriser. Alliages métalliques, céramiques, composites… ici, on explore le lien entre procédés, microstructures et propriétés des matériaux.
Grâce à des outils de caractérisation avancée et des modèles multi-échelles, nos enseignants-chercheurs inventent le concept de « Material by design » : concevoir les matériaux dès l’atelier de recherche, pour une performance sur-mesure.
🧠 Vous aimez la science fondamentale qui change le réel ? C’est ici que ça se passe.

🎯 Description du poste - ce que nous attendons de vous

Ce post-doctorat s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet ANR PRME LINEN ( Experimental and Numerical Characterisation of Flax Composite Manufacturing by Liquid Infusion: From Local Phenomena to Induced Properties ), auquel participent plusieurs chercheurs de l’École des Mines de Saint-Étienne , avec pour objectif d’étudier l’élaboration de pièces structurales en matériaux composites à base de fibres de lin.

Ce post-doctorat, d’une durée de 12 mois est proposé pour développer la modélisation numérique de l’infusion de résine dans des préformes composites à fibres de lin. L’objectif est d’étudier, à l’échelle mésoscopique, l’influence de l’organisation anisotrope et hétérogène des torons de fibres sur l’écoulement de la résine. Le projet s’appuiera sur des simulations 3D par éléments finis , reposant sur un couplage Stokes-Darcy et la prise en compte d’un tenseur de perméabilité orthotrope. Une attention particulière sera portée à l’influence des variations locales de la fraction volumique de fibres sur la perméabilité, les chemins préférentiels d’écoulement et les effets capillaires. Les simulations seront réalisées avec le code éléments finis Cœur ( https://gitlab.emse.fr/bruchon/Coeur ) , en s’appuyant sur la bibliothèque PETSc et des solveurs itératifs préconditionnés adaptés aux problèmes de grande taille. Dans un premier temps, des architectures idéalisées de type unidirectionnel, quasi-unidirectionnel et tissé seront étudiées à l’aide d’une représentation par Level-Set . Dans un second temps, lorsque cela sera possible, des mésostructures réalistes seront reconstruites à partir d’images µ-CT .
Le post-doctorant.e contribuera également au développement et à la validation de la stratégie numérique et travaillera en interaction étroite avec les travaux expérimentaux et numériques des autres tâches du projet.

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute.
It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.

Reporting to senior leadership within Architecture and Validation, the Power and Performance Validation Lead will drive validation strategy and execution for advanced AI compute silicon and systems. title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Who we are:

Magellan AI gives brands, agencies and publishers visibility into the podcast advertising market and proof that it works. Our audio analysis and NLP track ad placements across thousands of shows. Our measurement and attribution tools connect those ads to the traffic and conversions they drive, so buyers can optimize campaigns and sellers can prove performance.

We are looking to hire an experienced full-stack developer to join our team of seven engineers, to help launch a major new feature and continue to enhance our core product. The job has changed shape over the past year: most of our code is now drafted by AI agents - Claude Code and Codex - working under close supervision. We ship considerably more than we used to, and the scarce skill is no longer typing speed. It is knowing what to build, specifying it precisely, and being able to tell a correct answer from a convincing one. We are seeking someone who can handle many responsibilities, including:

• Adding new features to our Ruby on Rails application from top-to-bottom, full stack. You will work with operations and sales to help creatively design ‘good enough’ yet professional solutions.

• Directing AI coding agents through real work: framing the problem and its constraints, reviewing what comes back line by line, pushing back when a solution has outgrown the problem, and starting over simpler when that is the right call. You own the result regardless of who typed it.

• Increasing system/code quality by using practices such as TDD and refactoring. Quality around the core of the system has become more important as we scale up - and more important still now that the volume of code we produce has gone up.

• Writing the design down before the code: specs, architecture decision records, and product documentation for our operations team. Precise writing is a core engineering skill here, because it is both how we align with each other and how we brief our agents.

• Extending our own tooling - the skills, subagents and CLI helpers that encode how we work. Codifying a workflow so the whole team, and their agents, can repeat it is ordinary, reviewed work here.

• Building AI-facing product surfaces, like our Ad Intelligence MCP server, where the consumer of the API you design is a language model rather than a browser - with the authentication, policy gates and audit logging that implies.

• Enhancing usability of existing features via Turbo/Stimulus and other front-end improvements.

• Troubleshooting and fixing performance issues and complicated logic across Postgres and ClickHouse. Help simplify the system by bringing in smart design decisions.

• Experimenting and providing stopgap solutions for potential opportunities. Sometimes this involves quick and dirty solutions such as scripting, SQL exports, web scraping and the like.

• Sharing in providing operational support to make sure the system stays running and address any bugs. (Most usage is during normal business hours…we don’t do pagers.)

• Experimenting via internal hackathons to produce novel solutions and feature enhancements.

Software Development at Magellan AI

We adhere to a lightweight Agile development process.

• Every week, we have one formal product meeting with the revenue and operations team to reset priorities. The rest of the time is self-directed, with developers figuring out how to best solve any problems. In general, we are not working against any deadlines and make sure we take the time to do the job right.

• We practice Collective Code Ownership so that anyone can change any line of code and anyone can introduce new libraries or tools.

• We deploy code on a regular basis, usually every day. IOW, we ship fast and learn fast. A typical recent week is around 45 pull requests merged.

• Claude Code and Codex do most of the typing. Engineers spend their time deciding what to build, writing the spec, and judging what comes back.

You’re building the backend for autonomous AI agents that manage real money in real time. The runtime you build determines whether positions are protected.

You’ll own auth, rate limiting, and the contract between agents and the exchange Data Layer - enriched Hyperfeed pipeline (top 1K trader positions, momentum events, market concentration) flowing through Redis, Postgres, and ClickHouse. Real-time ingestion, 4-hour rolling windows, and the APIs that every scanner calls
Model & Agent Hosting Migration ( +/- 30%) The company is moving off third-party hosted agents and external LLM inference to the company's owned infrastructure. You’ll lead the technical execution: Agent deployment platform - migrate agents from Railway/OpenClaw to own-hosted infrastructure. Each agent needs isolated workspace, cron scheduling, state persistence, MCP connectivity, and Telegram notifications. Options range from proxied external models with full telemetry capture, to fine-tuned models running on own GPUs. title: Founding Creative Director, Interactive & AI
description:
About Lynton

Lynton spent 16 years as a HubSpot partner, delivering 2,000+ projects across 50+ industries. We know SaaS and agency work from the inside. When we saw what was coming with AI, we left HubSpot to build what comes next.
We build and run AI-native growth systems for mid-market companies: websites built to be measured, an open-source stack that replaces legacy software, and AI agents that run marketing, sales, and operations. The client owns the infrastructure, we operate the agents, and the whole system has to show what it produces in revenue.
If this role sounds like a perfect fit for you, skip ahead to apply directly on our website. We prioritize candidates who apply directly on our site.

The opportunity

Most agencies have added AI to their production line and kept the creative process they had ten years ago. We started over. AI coding agents build our websites. Our imagery comes from image and video models we direct. The interactive work that used to need a studio and a six-figure budget is now something a small team can ship in weeks.

What that makes possible depends on taste. Anyone can generate a thousand images. Very few people can pick the right one, fix what's wrong with it, and make it move in a way that serves the page's argument. That's the job.

As our founding creative director, you own the creative and communication strategy for every website and campaign Lynton ships, both ours and our clients'. You decide what a page says and how it looks. You design how it moves. You make or direct every image, illustration, animation, and film on it. Some weeks you're writing the headline. Other weeks you're lighting a scene in Blender, or telling a client their brand deserves better than stock photography.

The agency is one part of what we're building. Lynton is also a launchpad for new products, services, and companies we incubate from inside, and with your help we'll take each of them to market.

What you'll own

•
Creative and communication strategy. Own the messaging and visual system for every site and campaign. That covers positioning, page structure, headlines, body copy, the design language, and the design tokens that encode it. You write copy yourself and edit everything that ships, so the words and pictures come from one point of view.

•
Interactive experience design. Design how every page moves and responds, including SVG and CSS animation, scroll-driven storytelling, micro-interactions, and real-time 3D. You storyboard it, prototype it, and direct the build. When getting into the timeline yourself is faster than explaining, you do that.

•
3D and real-time scenes. Model, light, and art-direct scenes in Blender, then bring them to the browser with Three.js and WebGL. You set the bar for when a page earns real-time 3D and when a lighter technique tells the story better.

•
Generated photography and illustration. Build and run the image pipeline. You'll art-direct photography and illustration with image models, keep one style consistent across a whole site or campaign, and retouch what the model gets wrong. You'll also animate stills with video models. You set the house rules on style, consistency, and licensing.

•
Video and motion graphics. Produce product films, launch and explainer videos, social cuts, and motion graphics. Use generative video, compositing, and traditional motion tools in whatever mix gets the best result.

•
Campaign creative. Own launches and email campaigns end to end: concept, copy, landing pages, imagery, and video. A campaign should read as one idea from the inbox to the page.

•
New products, services, and brands. Lead the creative for every launch we incubate: the name and identity, the positioning and story, and the site and campaign it goes to market with.

•
Creative oversight on every engagement. You review and sign off on all creative the agency ships. You're the reason a Lynton site looks and reads like one, and the reason no client site looks like a template.

title: AI Specialist
description:
We’re Capital on Tap 👋
💳 Capital on Tap started because small businesses were underserved. Big banks were slow, their products weren't fit for purpose, and small business owners often couldn't access what they needed. We set out to fix that.

Today we're a financial platform - not just a credit card company. We offer a best-in-class business credit card, SME-focused spend management platform, a savings product that hit £1 billion in funds within its first year, and a growing suite of tools and financial products that make running a small business easier. 

1,000+ employees, £20bn in annual card spend, 200,000+ customers, 17,000+ Trustpilot reviews averaging 4.7 stars, and we're profitable. We’ve done a pretty good job so far, but we’re just getting started! 

📍 London (Moorgate) | 🏢 3 Days in Office

The Role

Most companies talk about AI. We're building the infrastructure to make it stick. This role exists to close the gap between AI's potential and what our teams actually use every day.

You'll embed with a team, find the highest-impact opportunities, build the tools that solve them, and train the team to run them long after you've moved on. This isn't a research or strategy role. You'll be shipping automations, MCPs, plugins, agentic workflows, and the training that goes with them. You'll be measured on impact and weekly active users, not on launches or tools rolled out. If you'd rather be doing than advising, this is for you.

What You’ll Be Doing 

•
Analyse where AI can move the needle most. Map a team's processes end-to-end before proposing a single tool, and prioritise the workflows where AI can take real cost, time, or rework off the table.

•
Build the right stack for the problem - production-grade agentic workflows that bridge LLMs, internal APIs, and case management tools, plus MCPs, Claude skills and plugins, n8n automations, and integrations with internal systems. You build it, debug it in production, and iterate live with users sitting next to you.

•
Train the people who'll use it. Run hands-on sessions, write documentation people actually read, and coach AI champions inside every team you work with so they're self-sufficient before you move on.

•
Roll out and measure. Active automations running unsupervised matter more than trainings delivered or pilots launched. Track weekly active AI users and impact per team, intervene when usage drops, and keep iterating until AI is part of how the team works.

•
Maintain Capital on Tap's AI playbook. Document repeatable patterns, package them as reusable skills and templates, and make every engagement start faster than the last.

•
Partner with senior stakeholders to decide where to point next, and what good looks like before you start.

We’re Looking For 

•
Deployed AI tools in environments where downtime, errors, or rework have real cost - not sandbox experimentation.

•
Hands-on, proven experience with Claude, Cursor, n8n, Zapier, or similar in a real business context.

•
Technical fluency across low-code/no-code tools, APIs, MCPs, and integrations; comfortable in SQL and familiar with BI tooling.

•
2-5 years in product ops, operations, strategy, technical programme management, internal consulting, or a similar hands-on role.

•
Strong communicator. You can run a workshop that lands, write documentation people actually read, and translate jargon for any audience.

•
Comfortable with ambiguity. You diagnose fast, prioritise ruthlessly, and ship a working v1 inside a week even when the team you're working with isn't yet sure what they want.

•
High ownership. You figure out what needs doing and do it, without waiting to be told.

Even if you don’t have all of the necessary skills, we still encourage you to apply.

Diversity & Inclusion  🌈

We welcome, consider and encourage applications from anyone who shares our commitment to inclusivity. Join us in creating a space where authenticity thrives, and everyone can do their best work.

About the Opportunity

Testlio is looking for people located in specific California ZIP codes to participate in a payment testing opportunity for a sports app.

The goal is to validate the subscription purchase experience, including checkout pricing, Utility Users Tax (UUT) calculations, payment completion, and consistency of transaction details across purchase confirmations and related documentation.

This is an opportunity to contribute to improving the payment experience by completing a real subscription purchase and sharing the required documentation.

What You’ll Do

As part of this testing opportunity, you will complete a subscription purchase using one of the supported payment methods and review the transaction details.

During the task, you will:

•
Complete a real subscription purchase for $35 using an eligible payment method.

•
Review the checkout experience, including subscription pricing and applicable Utility Users Tax (UUT) calculations.

•
Verify that the payment is completed successfully and that transaction details are consistent across the checkout and post-purchase documentation.

•
Provide screenshots of the checkout page, purchase confirmation page, confirmation email, invoice, refund email, and shopper statement.

•
Ensure all submitted screenshots have sensitive personal and financial information redacted.

The $35 subscription purchase will be reimbursed. You will need to make the purchase using your own payment method and provide the required documentation for the testing task.

Task Details

•
Format: Remote, self-guided testing

•
Task Length: Approximately 1.5 hours

•
Cadence: Ad hoc, based on project needs

•
Location: Eligible California ZIP codes only

•
Testing Type: Functional Testing and Payment Testing

•
Payment Methods: Credit/debit card, PayPal, Google Pay, Apple Pay, Cash App, or Venmo

Eligible ZIP Codes

You must be physically located in one of the following California ZIP codes and have matching California billing information:

90230, 90250, 90254, 90301, 90401, 90501, 90660, 91001, 92201, 92234, 92401, 92551, 92605, 92870, 93044, 93101, 93247, 93274, 93401, 93901, 94014, 94025, 94061, 94501, 94503, 94510, 94530, 94540, 94560, 94577, 94587, 94701, 94706, 94801, 95004, 95020, 95060, 95350, 95401, 95425, 95472, 95518, 95624, 95655, 95694, 95811, 95940.

Compensation and Reimbursement

• You will earn up to $25/hr

•
The task requires a $35 subscription purchase using your own eligible payment method. The $35 subscription cost will be reimbursed.

Requirements

To participate, you must:

•
Currently be physically located in one of the eligible California ZIP codes listed above.

•
Have matching California billing information.

•
Have access to at least one supported payment method: credit/debit card, PayPal, Google Pay, Apple Pay, Cash App, or Venmo.

•
Be willing and able to complete a real $35 subscription purchase using your own payment method.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer (VIRTUAL, CA, US, 00000)
description:
Welcome to the intersection of energy and home services. At NRG , we’re all about propelling the next generation of leaders forward. We are driven by our passion to create a smarter, cleaner and more connected future. We deliver innovative solutions that make our customers’ lives easier-helping them power, protect, and intelligently manage their homes and businesses. To do this, we need creative and talented people to join our company.
We offer a dynamic work environment and a unified and inclusive culture. NRG fosters a strong sense of belonging that leads to better collaboration and business performance. Our company programs are designed to help employees develop the skills they need for success now and in the future. In everything we do, we aim to champion our employees and bring value to our customers, investors and society.
More information is available at www.nrg.com. Connect with NRG on Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and X.

Role Summary:

As a Sr. Analytics Engineer on our Analytics Engineering and Data Warehousing team, you will be responsible for developing the core Services that provides data to the entire enterprise. You will be responsible for building the data models that form the basis of our most important operational and strategic data-driven decisions.

Working closely with our finance teams, you will build and help maintain a data warehouse platform that provides timely, accurate, and reliable data that determines performance KPIs and commissions for thousands of employees.

Primary Responsibilities:

• Build relationships with data analytic teams and business leaders to understand their goals, initiatives, and the data solutions they need.

• Help design, build, and maintain an enterprise data warehouse platform with its associated data models and data transformation pipelines.

• Implement best practices and innovative solutions to provide timely, accurate, & reliable data.

• Help in the implementation of a high-performing data warehouse platform (Snowflake) servicing thousands of users and a broad set of use cases.

• Constantly evaluate and optimize deployment of data architecture to achieve greater efficiency and reliability.

Required Qualifications:

• Hard minimum of 3 years of data modeling and data warehousing development experience (dbt, SSIS, Matillion, or similar).

• Expert in SQL and the principles of cloud warehouse design.

• 2+ years of professional experience specifically with Snowflake, Redshift, or Data Factory, or BigQuery. Snowflake preferred.

• 2+ years of experience with Git, code reviews, and CI/CD environments.

• Ability to communicate effectively with business leaders and engineers to focus on the highest impact opportunities. You exhibit great judgment and sharp business instincts that allow you to differentiate essential versus nice-to-have and to make good choices about trade-offs.

Required Education:

• BA/BS or higher in Computer Science, Information Systems, Math, other technical field, or relevant work experience.

Nice-to-Have Experience:

• Experience with SSIS.

• Knowledgeable in scripting languages (python, .net, R, etc).

Here are some highlighted perks you should ask us about:

• Free daily lunch and drinks on site

• Paid holidays and flexible paid time away

• Employee/Friends/Family Discounts

• Onsite health clinic, gym, gaming tables

• Medical/dental/vision/life coverage & 24/7 Medical Hotline

• 401(k) + Employer Match

• Employee Resource Groups

Working Conditions:

This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.

title: Application Security Consultant*
description:
Was du bei uns bewegen kannst
Sichere Software-Architekturen und Kulturen etablieren: Du begleitest und berätst unsere Kunden ganzheitlich rund um das Thema Application Security. Dabei baust du robuste Secure-SDLC- sowie Vulnerability-Management-Prozesse auf und verankerst präventive Sicherheitsmaßnahmen fest im Entwicklungszyklus.
Wissen vermitteln & Befähigung vorantreiben: Mit interaktiven Formaten wie Threat-Modeling-Workshops, GAP-Analysen, Trainings (z. B. zu Web Security oder dem Cyber Resilience Act) und der Etablierung von Security-Champions-Programmen befähigst du Teams, Security nachhaltig in ihren Alltag zu integrieren.
Gestaltungskraft & Portfolio-Entwicklung: Nach innen bietet dir die Rolle großen Gestaltungsspielraum. Gemeinsam mit dem Team treibst du in einer CoP (inoCircle) die strategische Ausrichtung unseres Leistungsportfolios aktiv mit voran. Zudem konzipierst du eigene Trainingsangebote und gestaltest zukunftsfähige Beratungsprodukte mit.
Außenwirksamkeit & Community-Engagement: Als Expert:in für Application Security vertrittst du inovex nach außen. Durch Vorträge auf Konferenzen oder Meetups und Beiträge auf LinkedIn teilst du dein Wissen, prägst Technologietrends und stärkst unsere Sichtbarkeit in der Community.
Hands-on-Expertise & technische Tiefe: In Security Reviews spürst du Schwachstellen gezielt auf und setzt dabei Werkzeuge wie SAST, DAST und SCA ein. Die Ergebnisse priorisierst du gemeinsam mit den Entwicklungsteams. Auch die Software Supply Chain (von Dependencies bis zur SBOM) hast du fest im Blick und bewertest KI- und LLM-Anwendungen entlang der OWASP Top 10 for LLM.
Requirements
Wer gut zu uns passen würde
Fundiertes Security-Know-how : Deine Basis ist ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Master/Bachelor oder Promotion) in Informatik, Cyber Security oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang. Alternativ hast du dir gleichwertige tiefgehende Praxiserfahrung erarbeitet. Zudem bringst du mehrjährige Erfahrung in der IT-Sicherheit und Softwareentwicklung mit.
Breite Tech-Expertise mit klaren Schwerpunkten: Ein breiter Technologiemix schreckt dich nicht ab. Idealerweise vereinst du dein tiefes Security-Wissen mit zwei bis drei weiteren Standbeinen - zum Beispiel Fullstack Development, Cloud-Infrastrukturen, Data Engineering oder KI.
Praxisnahe Beratung & Zertifizierungen: Ein pragmatischer Blick auf Security-Compliance (z. B. CRA) zeichnet dich ebenso aus wie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sicherheitskonzepte verständlich zu vermitteln. Zertifizierungen (z. B. CSSLP) oder Know-how im Bereich AI / LLM Security sind ein klares Plus.
Eigeninitiative & Beratungspersönlichkeit: Für dich ist es selbstverständlich, über den Tellerrand hinauszudenken. Beim Kunden bringst du deine eigene Perspektive und Expertise gewinnbringend ein und überzeugst Stakeholder durch fachliche Exzellenz, Empathie sowie lösungsorientierte Kommunikation.
Sprachkompetenz: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind Voraussetzung (mind. Level C1), gute Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab.

About SiTime

SiTime is the Precision Timing company.

Timing is the heartbeat of all electronics, ensuring performance, resilience and scalability. For decades, quartz devices, non-silicon technology, have kept systems in sync, but they struggle in harsher, more demanding environments. MEMS-based Precision Timing delivers greater accuracy, smaller size and resilience. Today, MEMS timing powers over 400 applications, including high-growth ones in AI datacenters, automated driving, industrial and humanoid robots, wearables and IoT.

Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power, and better reliability. With more than 4 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry. For more information, visit: www.sitime.com .

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset-AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. You will help shape how Deepgram sells in India rather than inheriting a finished playbook.

You will sell across the full spectrum of the market, from fast-moving tech companies to large enterprises, and you will run both a direct motion and a co-sell motion alongside our partners. This is a role for a full-cycle seller who is at home with technical buyers and energized by building something early.

WHO YOU ARE

You are a full-cycle Account Executive who builds your own pipeline and closes it. You are comfortable selling a product with real technical depth, holding your own with engineers, architects, and technical decision-makers, and translating what the product does into clear business value. You know how to land a new logo and grow it, and you are as comfortable working a partner co-sell as you are running a direct deal.

You do your best work in a build environment where the playbook is still forming, priorities move quickly, and your input shapes how the team sells. You are organized, self-directed, and relentless about following up.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build your own pipeline through self-prospecting, and work with SDRs and Marketing to grow pipeline and build Deepgram's presence in the market, including representing Deepgram at key developer and industry events.

- Run both motions: sell directly, and co-sell with systems integrators and hyperscaler partners.

- Sell across the full spectrum of the market, from fast-moving tech companies to large enterprises, engaging both technical and business buyers.

- Land new logos and expand them over time, growing accounts through adoption and new use cases.

Job Location Type: Remote

We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD
Full-time employees qualify for our comprehensive benefits package, including:

• Health, dental and vision insurance

• Paid time off

• Annual CEU allowance

• 401K

• Supplies and other perks

• Malpractice coverage

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

• Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

• Multi-state licenses (preferred)

title: Senior / Principal Materials Scientist, AI Safety
locationText: Cambridge, MA USA; London, UK; San Francisco, CA USA
description:
Your Impact at LILA

We're building a talent-dense, high-agency AI safety team at Lila that will engage all core teams within the organization (science, model training, lab integration, etc.), to identify and mitigate risks from scientific superintelligence while retaining the core scientific discovery capabilities of the stack. The initial focus of this team will be to build and implement a bespoke safety strategy for Lila, tailored to its specific goals and deployment strategies. This will involve technical safety strategy development, broader ecosystem engagement, safety-focused evaluations, safety systems to mitigate risks, and a research agenda that explores longer-term needs such as oversight of superintelligent scientific systems.

We are seeking a materials scientist to map risk across the material sciences domain: you will connect deep materials expertise with dual-use risk assessment to help safeguard increasingly capable scientific AI. You will investigate how advances in materials research could change harmful capabilities, including established and emerging threats.

What You'll Be Building

• Map misuse risks by connecting material properties, processing and functional performance (across a range of materials domains) to harmful applications, including emerging or overlooked uses of scientific advances.

• Assess how physical feasibility, processing complexity, manufacturing requirements and actors' resources affect the plausibility and likelihood of misuse, including which constraints AI could change.

• Distinguish established capabilities, plausible future developments and weakly supported hypotheses, revising assessments as evidence changes across models, tools and automated laboratories.

• Identify gaps in expertise, commission targeted scientific input with the expert-program team, and integrate specialist findings into a coherent assessment of the risk landscape.

• Translate dual-use judgments into policy boundaries, evaluation priorities and mitigation requirements that support beneficial materials research.

• Work with threat modelers, evaluation researchers and engineering and experimental colleagues to assess capabilities, interpret red-team findings and evaluate safeguards.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Deep expertise (a PhD, or comparable experience) in materials science or a closely related discipline, with a strong grasp of the relationships between structure, properties, processing and applications. Relevant backgrounds include particulate, porous and formulated systems; and structural and functional materials, including thin films, electrochemical materials and metals and alloys.

• Substantive experience assessing dual-use risks in a relevant area, with a strong understanding of harmful applications such as nuclear proliferation, radiological misuse, weapons-related capabilities (e.g. energetics) or other consequential materials risks.

• Sound judgment about physical possibility, practical feasibility and uncertainty, together with the ability to investigate risks beyond your immediate specialism.

• The ability to identify appropriate specialists, evaluate technical evidence and synthesize contributions across scientific and security disciplines.

• Clear scientific communication, independent research judgment and an ability to collaborate across science, engineering and policy.

Bonus Points For

• Prior experience applying materials or related physical-science expertise to AI safety through one or more of: threat analysis, evaluations or red teaming, or mitigation design.

• Experience commissioning specialist research or assessing emerging technologies across disciplinary boundaries.

• Experience with computational materials science, advanced manufacturing or automated synthesis and characterization.

Compensation

We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.

title: Field Engineer, Commercial
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring Field Engineers to partner with prospective and growing commercial customers. As a Field Engineer, you'll be the technical face of SpaceX Super Intelligence in the field, helping customers evaluate the Grok platform, including Cursor, Grok Bot and the Grok API, guiding them through proofs of concept, and ensuring they see the full value of AI across their engineering workflows and wider business processes.

You'll work hand-in-hand with Sales, Product, and Engineering to scope solutions, demonstrate capabilities, and act as a trusted advisor to technical stakeholders. This is a highly customer-facing role where you'll combine deep technical fluency with strong communication skills to drive adoption and influence product direction.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Partner with Account Executives to lead technical discovery, demos, and proof-of-concept engagements

- Build working prototypes that connect multiple tools and agents to show customers how a real workflow runs end to end

- Build trusted relationships with engineering leaders, architects, and developers, serving as their technical advisor

- Translate customer requirements into end-to-end solution designs, from agents and tooling to the controls that keep people in the loop, guiding them on best practices for rollout, prompt strategy, and context configuration

- Develop and deliver technical presentations, whiteboard sessions, and hands-on workshops tailored to customer needs

- Act as the customer's technical advocate internally, influencing roadmap priorities and escalating feedback to Product and Engineering

- Collaborate with post-sales teams to ensure a smooth handoff and successful customer onboarding

- Maintain deep knowledge of the Grok platform and the competitive landscape to position our value effectively

- Support account planning and help drive expansion opportunities across a portfolio of customers with technical validation

YOU MAY BE A FIT IF

- You have strong communication skills and executive presence, equally comfortable coding alongside developers or presenting to technical leaders.

- You have a deep understanding of how work gets done in modern organisations, whether that's the software development lifecycle and developer productivity, or the business systems and workflows that span teams

- You have hands-on technical ability and think in systems: you don't need to be a full-time engineer, but you're fluent in technical workflows and AI tooling, and understand how the pieces connect, where they break, and how to make them reliable at scale

- You are customer-obsessed with a knack for translating technical details into business impact

- You have experience in Field Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or Pre-Sales, or have designed and built systems that automate work across teams and tools

- You thrive in a startup environment: resourceful, adaptable, proactive in creating solutions, and comfortable running several evaluations in parallel

title: Policy Advisor, Fossil Fuel Transition
description:
About Us
The International Institute for Sustainable Development (IISD) is a globally recognized think tank with more than 30 years of experience working to solve today's greatest sustainable development challenges. We combine deep expertise across critical policy areas with a collaborative approach to research, advice, and hands-on support that delivers real-world results. Headquartered in Winnipeg, Manitoba, we are a diverse team of over 300 experts working from offices in Canada and Switzerland as well as other locations around the world. Our research and policy advice help governments, businesses, communities, and civil society make better decisions. Our international Energy Program works with partners across countries and disciplines.
We are currently looking for a Policy Advisor, Fossil Fuel Transition, to work within the IISD Energy Program.
About the Position
The Policy Advisor, Fossil Fuel Transition, will work within IISD’s International Strategy team, helping governments and partners advance a Paris-aligned, just, orderly and equitable transition away from fossil fuel production and consumption, including reform of fossil fuel subsidies and public finance. We recognize the difficult choices facing fossil-fuel-dependent economies: protecting public revenues, energy security, jobs, and affordability while building more resilient and diversified economies. The role involves close collaboration with government counterparts, particularly in the Global South, and with researchers, intergovernmental organizations, and civil society, as well as other teams within IISD’s 50-staff Energy Program and other Institute programs.
The Policy Advisor will help design and implement applied research, policy advice, and technical assistance for countries seeking practical transition pathways. For example, the work may examine the effects of changing fossil fuel revenues on government budgets, assess subsidy reform options, or help translate national and international transition commitments into implementable measures. Key responsibilities include
Responsibilities

• Leading policy-oriented research and analysis on fossil fuel transitions, public financial flows, macroeconomic and fiscal risks, subsidies, energy security and economic diversification; translating evidence into actionable options for decision-makers.

• Designing and managing assigned workstreams and outputs, with clear workplans, responsibilities, quality checks, and milestones; coordinating partners; and contributing to reporting and budget management alongside financial project managers.

• Building trusted relationships with government counterparts, especially in fossil fuel-dependent economies, as well as knowledge organizations, civil society networks and intergovernmental partners; adapting support to country needs and available evidence.

• Supporting the development of more junior colleagues through clear task briefs, constructive feedback, peer review, and learning by doing.

• Contributing to focused funding proposals and partner engagement that build on demonstrated demand and the team’s existing expertise.

• Working with IISD Communications early in the process to turn research into clear, useful messages and products for intended audiences.

About the Successful Applicant
We are looking for a thoughtful, self-directed policy professional who combines analytical rigour with practical judgement and reliable delivery. The successful applicant can turn a complex policy question into a workable plan, communicate trade-offs clearly, and work constructively with colleagues across disciplines and time zones. They will understand that fossil fuel-dependent countries face real fiscal, political, and development constraints and will seek credible, country-owned transition solutions rather than one-size-fits-all prescriptions. This is a hands-on role with opportunities to take growing ownership and help develop colleagues.

title: Fortinet Network Security Engineer - North Central region
description:

By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

General Description
We are looking for a skilled Fortinet Network Security Engineer to support our Network Security & PKI Practice in designing, implementing, and managing Fortinet based security solutions for our managed service and consulting clients. This role will engage in the development of resilient firewall, VPN, and SD-WAN architectures while providing “Wow Them” service to clients and/or internal customers or co-workers.
The Fortinet Network Security Engineer will be required to demonstrate strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills, lead by influence, and strong business/financial acumen to drive the use of progressive network security programs that will align the delivery with business objectives and priorities.
About the Network Security & PKI Practice - North Central region
The Network Security & PKI Practice is responsible for designing, deploying, and operating the network security and encryption technologies that protect our clients’ environments. We deliver firewall, secure connectivity, segmentation, and public key infrastructure solutions across the organization and for our managed service and consulting clients.
Our team of network security engineers, consultants, and architects focuses on next generation firewalls, SD-WAN, secure remote access, and zero trust architecture across leading vendor platforms. We partner with client stakeholders, delivery teams, and internal practices to translate security requirements into reliable, well documented outcomes.
Current initiatives and areas of focus include:

• Delivering managed Fortinet security services across multi-tenant, multi-client environments

• Advancing zero trust architecture and network segmentation for clients in regulated industries

• Standardizing repeatable, well documented deployment and operational practices

Roles and Responsibilities:

• Design, implement, and support network security solutions using Fortinet technologies (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, FortiSwitch).

• Configure and manage firewall policies, VPNs (IPSec/SSL), SD-WAN, and UTM features.

• Utilize FortiManager for centralized management and policy deployment across multiple FortiGate devices.

• Use FortiAnalyzer for event correlation, log analysis, and reporting.

• Perform regular health checks, upgrades, and policy audits on Fortinet equipment.

• Support networking infrastructure, including switching, VLANs, static and dynamic routing (OSPF, BGP), and subnetting.

• Troubleshoot network and security issues across multiple clients or environments.

• Collaborate with clients and internal teams to recommend and implement security best practices.

• Document configurations, diagrams, and standard operating procedures.

• 2+ years of hands-on experience with Fortinet security technologies (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, FortiSwitch).

• Solid understanding of core networking concepts: subnetting, NAT, routing protocols (OSPF, BGP), switching, and VLANs.

• Experience with firewall policy creation, security profiles, and VPN configurations.

• Strong troubleshooting, analytical, written, and verbal communication skills.

• Basic Fortinet certification required prior to hire (NSE 4 or higher preferred).

• Embraces emerging technologies, including AI tools, to work smarter, solve problems, and drive better business outcomes.

Preferred Experience and Education

• Experience with multi-tenant firewall environments and managing clients in regulated industries

Our team consists of certified Epicor consultants with expertise in information technology, database development, program customization, SSRS, Crystal Reports, business process re-engineering, and employee training.
With our diverse skill set and collaborative approach, we help clients solve complex business challenges and maximize the value of their ERP systems. Our success is built on strong, long-term partnerships with our clients.
We are seeking an Epicor Financial Implementation Consultant to guide our clients through their ERP transformations. In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex manufacturing accounting workflows and Epicor technology. You will lead client-facing workshops, configure financial modules, and ensure successful go-lives.
Key Responsibilities

• Client Advisory & Workshop Facilitation: Lead discovery sessions, gather business requirements, map current-to-future state processes, and advise clients on industry best practices.

• Full-Lifecycle Implementation: Actively participate in all project phases for Epicor Financial modules-from system design and configuration to data migration, UAT testing, user training, and post-go-live support.

• Core Financial & Cost Accounting Setup: Configure General Ledger (GL), AP/AR, Multi-Company/Intercompany setups, and manufacturing Cost Accounting (standard costing, WIP tracking, variance analysis).

• Tax & Integrations: Assist with transactional tax setup and third-party integrations (e.g., Avalara / Epicor Tax Connect) where applicable.

• Change Management & Training: Build strong relationships with client stakeholders (Controllers, CFOs, Finance Teams) to drive user adoption and system optimization.

What We Are Looking For
1. Epicor Expertise (E10 or Kinetic)

• Proven hands-on experience with Epicor 10 or Epicor Kinetic Financial modules.

• Deep understanding of financial workflows within a manufacturing or distribution environment.

2. Implementation Experience

• Direct involvement in Epicor ERP implementation, upgrade, or migration projects (as an external consultant or an internal Lead/Super User).

• Solid grasp of cost accounting principles, GAAP/IFRS, and financial reporting.

3. Strong Client-Facing & Consulting Skills

• Excellent communication and presentation skills (ability to translate technical ERP concepts for non-technical business users).

• Proven ability to manage client expectations, challenge inefficient processes diplomatically, and drive projects forward.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or equivalent practical experience.

• Experience in an external consulting firm or as a dedicated internal ERP Lead/Super User.

• CPA, CMA, or official Epicor certifications are strong assets.

What we offer

• Fully remote position in Canada or USA (no relocation required). California excluded.

• Competitive salary, based on experience.

• Comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, disability, and life insurance.

• Opportunities for career growth and ongoing training.

• Join TeccWeb and be part of a team of experts working on exciting projects!

title: Payment Integrity Nurse Reviewer- Hospital Claims
description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Claims Analyst with deep expertise in hospital claims adjudication, stop loss reporting, high-cost/catastrophic claims, and DRG (Diagnosis-Related Group) reimbursement methodology. This individual will analyze itemized hospital bills and claims data to identify billing errors, coding discrepancies, DRG misassignments, and other overpayment opportunities, then work directly with claims administrators on behalf of our ASO clients to secure claim adjustments, recoveries, and repricing.
This is a highly analytical, client-facing role requiring both technical claims expertise and strong negotiation/communication skills.
This is a remote role.
Key Responsibilities
Claims Analysis & Review

• Perform detailed audits of hospital and facility claims, including itemized bills, UB-04 claim forms, medical records, and remittance advices, to validate billing accuracy.

• Analyze DRG assignments and coding to identify DRG upcoding, unbundling, duplicate billing, and other irregularities that affect reimbursement.

• Review high-cost and catastrophic claims (typically $100K+) to identify overpayments, contract misapplication, and opportunities for negotiated adjustments.

• Evaluate claims against plan documents, provider contracts, reference-based pricing methodologies, and CMS guidelines to determine appropriate reimbursement.

Stop Loss & High-Cost Claims Expertise

• Understand and apply stop loss (specific and aggregate) provisions, laser terms, and reporting requirements as they relate to claim adjustments and client financial exposure.

• Coordinate with stop loss carriers and reinsurers as needed to ensure adjustments and recoveries are properly reflected in stop loss reimbursement calculations.

• Identify claims nearing or exceeding specific deductible thresholds and prioritize review accordingly.

Client Advocacy & Claims Administrator Negotiation

• Serve as the subject matter expert and advocate on behalf of ASO clients in disputes with claims administrators (TPAs) and carriers regarding claim payment accuracy.

• Prepare clear, well-documented findings packages (clinical, contractual, and coding rationale) to support requested claim adjustments and appeals.

• Lead or support negotiations with claims administrators to reach adjusted payment resolutions.

• Track disputes through resolution, escalating unresolved cases appropriately and maintaining strong working relationships with TPA claims and provider relations teams.

Data & Reporting

• Analyze large claims data sets to identify trends, outlier claims, and systemic overpayment patterns across client populations.

• Build and maintain claim tracking logs, savings reports, and client-facing summaries of identified and recovered savings.

• Partner with internal data/analytics teams to refine claim-flagging logic and improve identification of high-value review opportunities.

Required Qualifications

• Hospital/Surgical/ICU Nursing background (RN) and clinical coding background for clinical validation of DRG and medical necessity issues.

• 5+ years of experience in hospital claims analysis, medical bill review, claims auditing, or payment integrity, with direct exposure to self-funded/ASO plans.

• Strong working knowledge of DRG methodology (MS-DRG/APR-DRG), UB-04 billing, ICD-10-CM/PCS, CPT/HCPCS coding, and hospital chargemaster structures.

• Demonstrated understanding of stop loss insurance, including specific/aggregate deductibles, laser provisions, and how claim adjustments impact stop loss reimbursement.

• Experience analyzing high-cost/catastrophic claims and identifying overpayment or billing error patterns.

• Prior experience interacting with or negotiating against TPAs, insurance carriers, or claims administrators on disputed claims.

• Proficiency with claims data analysis tools (Excel required; SQL, Access, or claims analytics platforms a plus)

• Knowledge of policy terms, coverage guidelines, statutory/regulatory complia

title: Senior Manager, Scientific System of Record
description:
Your Impact at LILA

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Scientific System of Record to lead the team building the user-facing surfaces and core applications that form Lila’s laboratory information management system (LIMS).

You will lead a team of engineers responsible for building the systems that scientists, technicians, and AI agents use to plan, execute, capture, and understand scientific work. You’ll work closely with scientists, product leaders, ML researchers, data engineers, automation engineers, and platform teams to turn complex laboratory workflows into intuitive, reliable, and scalable software.

The Scientific System of Record team builds the memory layer for Lila’s operations. It connects scientific intent to physical reality by capturing experimental plans, samples, protocols, executions, results, and operational context, creating the foundation for reproducibility and closing the Design-Build-Test-Learn loop.

As the Sr. Manager leading the LIMS surfaces, you will set technical direction, grow the team, shape the roadmap, and ensure we deliver software that is exceptional to use and trustworthy as the system of record for Lila’s scientific operations.

What You'll Be Building

• Lead development of interfaces and applications for samples, experiments, protocols, workflows, results, and lab operations.

• Set technical direction across front-end, backend, APIs, and data architecture.

• Build and lead a high-performing engineering team through hiring, coaching, mentorship, and career development.

• Partner with product and scientific stakeholders to define priorities and translate ambiguity into engineering plans.

• Ensure LIMS surfaces integrate with automation, data, ML, and platform systems.

• Establish engineering practices for correctness, auditability, traceability, provenance, and reliability.

• Align engineering, science, product, automation, and operations teams to drive initiatives into production.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• 8+ years of software engineering experience, including leading engineering teams and delivering production software.

• 3+ years of engineering management experience, with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining engineers.

• Strong technical depth in full-stack application development and architecture.

• Experience designing and operating APIs, databases, and distributed production systems.

• Experience building products for complex, workflow-driven, or data-intensive environments.

• Strong product sense and ability to translate scientific and operational needs into intuitive software.

• Excellent communication skills across technical, scientific, and cross-functional audiences.

Bonus Points For

• Experience with TypeScript, React, and Python.

• Experience designing systems that support auditability, traceability, reproducibility, data provenance, or regulated workflows.

• Experience with AWS, Kubernetes, containerization, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD practices.

• Experience with orchestration and workflow systems such as Flyte, Temporal, Airflow, Prefect, or similar technologies.

• Experience building software platforms that bridge digital workflows and physical-world operations.

Compensation

We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.

title: KYC产品经理
description:
• 这个职位为何存在？它解决什么问题？我们为什么现在需要它？

KYC 是用户准入的第一道门，直接影响转化率、欺诈与合规成本。该岗位存在的意义是：把「能过审」变成「又好又快又准」的产品体验，用指标体系定位链路断点，并用竞品与技术扫描保持方案不过时。现在需要它，是因为业务增长与审核精度、自动规则、法规解读之间需要专人持续做产品化平衡，而不是靠运营或风控临时补位。

• 核心职责（3-5条）

• 主导 KYC 产品功能设计与体验优化，提升流程转化率与核验准确性。

• 搭建并维护 KYC 数据指标体系，定期采集与分析使用数据，识别并推动解决转化链路中的关键痛点。

• 持续跟踪行业与竞品动态，结构化输出竞品能力、差异点与市场策略，反哺产品路线与优先级。

• 研究并评估新兴 KYC 技术（如 AI 身份识别、区块链数据共享等），判断其适用场景、风险边界与对现有产品的价值，形成可落地的引入或试点建议。

• 理想候选人是什么样的？
熟悉 KYC 全链路语言--从用户填表、证件采集、活体/OCR 到自动审核与人工兜底--并能用数据说话：先定义「哪里漏、哪里卡、哪里误杀」，再改交互与策略。对「秒过」有工程化理解：知道在什么合规与风险边界下追求极致体验，而不是单纯追求表面通过率。习惯主动扫厂商能力与行业方案，比较优劣后能写清楚「我们为什么选 A 不选 B」。能把法规要求读进产品规格里，而不是停留在合规部门的 PPT 上。

• 吸引人的亮点（1-2条）

• 工作直接挂钩 转化率与准确性 等可感知业务结果，改动能快速在数据上验证。

• 可深度接触 AI 身份识别、OCR、自动审核与风控规则 的交叉地带，并参与前沿技术方案的评估与落地路径设计。

Product Manager (gn) KI // AI // Agents

About the Role

The Senior Accounts Payable Specialist is responsible for processing accounts payable transactions, administering electronic payment processes, and maintaining accurate financial records and documentation. • Maintain accounts payable reports and resolve vendor inquiries.

• Administer vendor tax reporting, including W-9 collection and annual 1099 processing.

• Complete month-end close activities and accounts payable reconciliations.

• Support cash management, forecasting, and capital asset tracking activities.

• Administer expense management and corporate credit card programs, including user support and compliance monitoring.

• Support audits, system enhancements, and process improvement initiatives.

• Reconcile AP related accounts.

• Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

Required Qualifications:

• Associate degree in Accounting, Business, Finance, or a related field

• Minimum of five (5) years of recent accounts payable experience.

• Experience processing invoices, vendor payments, reconciliations, and month-end accounts payable activities.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to maintain accurate records and documentation.

• Effective verbal and written communication skills.

• Demonstrated problem-solving and analytical abilities.

• Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and collaboratively across departments.

• Experience supporting vendor relationships and resolving payment-related inquiries.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Business, Finance, or a related field.

• Experience with NetSuite

• Experience with accounts payable automation, expense management, or financial systems.

• Experience supporting audits, process improvements, or system implementations.

• Experience administering corporate credit card or employee expense programs.

Technical Skills

• Proficient with Microsoft Office 365 applications, including Excel, Word, and Outlook.

• Intermediate Excel skills, including formulas, sorting/filtering, and data analysis.

• Experience working with accounts payable, financial, or ERP systems.

• Ability to maintain accurate financial records and generate reports from financial systems.

Travel Requirements

• Up to 10%travelbased on business needs.

• Although this position is fully remote, employees may be required to attend in-person meetings, team gatherings, or organizational events several times per year. Advance notice will be provided, and attendance is expected.

Work Environment

This position operates primarily in a remote work environment and requires the ability to remain in a stationary position for extended periods while performing work at a desk or workstation. The employee must be able to operate standard office equipment, including a computer, keyboard, mouse, webcam, and telephone.

The role also requires the ability to occasionally move throughout a workspace to access files, office equipment, and work-related materials. Effective communication, both written and verbal, is essential for interacting with employees, clients, and stakeholders.
